get_config_from_yaml: load a YAML config file with OmegaConf interpolation and return it as a frozen yacs CfgNode
resolve_omegaconf_to_dict: recursively convert an OmegaConf DictConfig or ListConfig to a plain Python dictionary resolving interpolations where possible
to_lower_dict_keys: convert all keys in a dictionary to lowercase and return the new dictionary
review_get_config: review the get_config function that loads YAML configs with OmegaConf interpolation support into a yacs CfgNode
test_resolve_omegaconf_to_dict: test the resolve_omegaconf_to_dict function with a DictConfig containing variable interpolation references
